{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rancor Holos''' were a series of gruesome [[Hologram/Legends|holos]] that depicted the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] at the hands of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]. They were sold by the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]], [[Dawn Arkanian|Thila]] and made her very rich. In reality, however, the holos were clever fakes; Thila was actually Dawn Arkanian, an operative of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who bought slaves and then transported them to Rebel [[Safe world/Legends|safe worlds]]. The holos were part of her cover as a sadistic slaver.
